audience: church staff who track members, groups, follow-ups and giving in ChMeetings

useCases.title: Find people who have no group yet
useCases.text: List people, and list the members of each group. Compare the two lists to find people with no group yet.

useCases.title: Review pending follow-ups for the week
useCases.text: List follow-ups filtered by status, assignee or scheduled date. Read the follow-up actions to see the types defined for the account.

useCases.title: Check attendance for one service
useCases.text: List the occurrences of an event in a date range, then read the attendance totals and the people marked attended or absent.

useCases.title: Assign a follow-up to a leader
useCases.text: Create a follow-up for one person and assign it to at least one assignee. Assignees with a user account are notified while it is pending.

useCases.title: Add a note to a member profile
useCases.text: Read the notes on one profile, then add a new note. Existing notes are not changed.

useCases.title: Review giving by campaign
useCases.text: List campaigns and the pledges made to each one. List contributions by person, date range or batch. Giving data is read-only.
